input: Latest-main Runtime control from commit 8cf3c22109b55e7d9c7e65b2698532f6fa7a19fc; Scheduler V3.0 and its exact Worker Control Manifest; generated Production prompt v2.3.0 with verified SHA-256 cd8eae87024b73fd17b343f0103a78b53472b9686fe31630297265e562d62c00; all ten required fetched-main sources; verified Production Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/08/2026-08-14/production-150513.json; and the three same-date Analysis Research Objects Q-20260814-01, Q-20260814-02 and Q-20260814-03, each ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true.
input_zh: 读取最新 main 提交 8cf3c22109b55e7d9c7e65b2698532f6fa7a19fc 上的 Runtime 控制源、Scheduler V3.0 与其声明的精确 Worker Control Manifest；确定性核验 Production Generated Prompt v2.3.0 的 SHA-256 为 cd8eae87024b73fd17b343f0103a78b53472b9686fe31630297265e562d62c00；完整读取全部 10 个 Required Source；核验 Production Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/08/2026-08-14/production-150513.json；并读取同日三份 Analysis Research Object Q-20260814-01、Q-20260814-02、Q-20260814-03，三者均为 ReadyForProduction 且 production_input_authorized=true。
workResult: Fail-closed admission passed and repository reconciliation granted Production execution authority as the earliest due unfinished task after Analysis completed. The run-date Execution Slot Opened state and a durable Worker Claimed event were persisted and verified before substantive work. All three eligible Research Objects were read and were sufficient for bounded bilingual article production. Production then reached a hard asset-gate failure: the available image-generation interface could not execute the required topic-specific editorial-cover instructions and instead returned unrelated Runtime-dashboard imagery. Such outputs are not valid Article Covers under Production prompt v2.3.0 and were discarded. Because coverGate cannot truthfully pass, no Publication Candidate bundle was committed and no public surface was modified.
workResult_zh: Fail-closed Admission 已通过；Analysis 完成后，仓库 Reconciliation 将 Production 判定为当前最早到期未收口任务并授予执行权。任何实质工作前，运行日 Execution Slot Opened 状态与持久 Worker Claimed 事件均已写入并核验。三份符合条件的 Research Object 已完整读取，证据足以支持有界的双语文章生产。随后 Production 遇到硬性资产门禁失败：当前可用的图像生成接口无法执行所需的主题化编辑题图指令，而是返回了与文章主题无关的 Runtime Dashboard 图像。按照 Production Prompt v2.3.0，这些输出不能作为 Article Cover，已丢弃。由于 coverGate 无法如实通过，本次没有提交任何 Publication Candidate Bundle，也没有修改任何公开发布表面。
output: No governed Publication Candidate was committed. Production closed as Failed with zero publishable output because the mandatory topic-specific Article Cover gate could not be satisfied with the actually available image-generation interface.
output_zh: 未提交任何受治理 Publication Candidate。由于实际可用的图像生成接口无法满足强制的主题化 Article Cover 门禁，Production 以 Failed 收口，可发布输出为 0。
next: Restore an image-generation path that can receive and faithfully execute the article-specific cover brief, then rerun Production from the same run-date Research Objects only if Runtime recovery policy explicitly permits reopening this Failed shift. Do not let Publication consume any uncommitted or failed Production artifact.
next_zh: 需要恢复能够接收并忠实执行文章级题图 Brief 的图像生成路径；仅在 Runtime Recovery Policy 明确允许重新打开本次 Failed 班次时，才能继续使用同运行日 Research Object 重跑 Production。Publication 不得消费任何未提交或来自失败 Production 的产物。
reason: Mandatory coverGate could not be satisfied: the available image-generation interface produced unrelated Runtime-dashboard imagery instead of article-specific editorial covers.
reason_zh: 强制 coverGate 无法满足：当前可用图像生成接口生成的是无关的 Runtime Dashboard 图像，而不是文章主题对应的编辑题图。
